sloka: पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदन्तरिक्षात्सुभास्वरा ।दिव्यदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैर्गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः।यद्वा -पुष्प वृष्टिः महति आसीत् अंतरिक्षात् सु भास्वरा ।दिव्य दुन्दुभि निर्घोषैः गीत वादित्र निःस्वनैः ॥१-७३-३७॥
transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭirmahatyāsīdantarikṣātsubhāsvarā ।divyadundubhinirghoṣairgītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ।yadvā -puṣpa vṛṣṭiḥ mahati āsīt aṁtarikṣāt su bhāsvarā ।divya dundubhi nirghoṣaiḥ gīta vāditra niḥsvanaiḥ ॥1-73-37॥

translations.english: While the descendants of Kakustha (Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata and Satrughna) held the elegant hands (of Sita, Urmila, Mandavi, and Srutakirti) there was a heavy rain of bright flowers from the sky.
